    How axi works

    1. Read the spec, plan, and tasks using the artifact list on the left.
    2. Annotate by selecting any text in the document, then writing a note about that exact passage.
    3. Comment on the whole feature by typing in the box and pressing Enter or the plus button. Notes stack up in the panel.
    4. Send the whole list to the agent with the "Send to agent" button below the box. Anything still typed goes along with it.
    5. The agent edits the files and replies here. Files it changed get a dot in the artifact list, and you can switch any changed file to "View changes" to see exactly what was added or removed.
